title: HistoWeave: reproducible spatial transcriptomics orchestration and evaluation platform
description: HistoWeave is an open-source orchestration and evaluation platform for reproducible spatial transcriptomics. Release v0.1.1 repairs the core runtime dependency contract for the submission freeze with 10 scientifically validated and 3 contract-validated multi-dataset evidence packages (13 total).
notes: Packaging hotfix: scikit-learn is now declared as a core dependency and release publishing smoke-tests the built wheel before upload. Canonical validation ledger: 10 scientific validated + 3 contract_validated = 13 multi-dataset evidence packages.
